assessment: This paper shows that haploinsufficiency of the ribosomal protein gene Rps12 in mice results in a number of phenotypes including defects in erythropoiesis, chronic pancytopenia, and loss of hematopoietic stem cell quiescence. This work will significantly add to the growing body of evidence that specific cell populations are particularly sensitive to global changes in mRNA translation. The manuscript contributes to our understanding of ribosome formation and function, mRNA translation, development, and stem cell biology.
